children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may bounce into a range of $6.80-1/2 to $6.83-3/4 per bushel, after stabilizing around support at $6.71.
The stabilization suggests a completion of the five-wave cycle from $7.36. A projection analysis on the fall from $7.30 reveals this 238.2% level of $6.71 - one of the endpoints of the cycle.
A break below $6.71 may cause a fall limited to $6.65-1/4, the other possible endpoint. A break above $6.83-3/4 may lead to a gain into the $6.90 to $6.95-3/4 range.
On the daily chart, the market is expected to stabilize around a support at $6.68-1/2, the 61.8% retracement of the uptrend from $5.90 to $7.94-1/2.
A decent bounce, a reversal of the downtrend from $7.94-1/2, or a continuation of the uptrend from $5.57-1/4 could occur.
